text:
jamal: Heads up — I committed a Hot Take: semver is an emotional support animal. Saw someone tag a config as v0.0.0 and it started crying. :sob:
anya: lol what happened?
jamal: They renamed a YAML anchor and the deploy pipeline turned into a soap opera. Example I found in the logs:
jamal: ```yaml
service:
  image: myapp:1.0
  env:
    - NAME: prod
  <<: *defaults
```
maria: classic. When in doubt, add another `-` somewhere and pray.
kevin: quick poll: worse to have bad semver or bad indentation?
anya: bad indentation. at least semver arguments are entertaining.
maria: :raised_hands: Indentation. One rogue space and CI summons demons.
bot-ci: lint-failure: YAML parse error at line 12 — reported by jamal
jamal: can we make semver optional in the office plant repo? :herb:
kevin: vote options: 1) semver for plants 2) open versioning 3) rollbacks by watering schedule
anya: 2
maria: 3
jamal: 1
kevin: 2
maria: also PSA — if you ever see me write `v2.0.0-beta+hotfix` I'm probably debugging at 1am. Proceed with caution.
anya: :laughing: noted.
kevin: someone should add a linter rule: "no semver in PR titles unless accompanied by coffee"
jamal: agreed. tagging ops @here — mandatory coffee for major bumps? :coffee:
maria: :thumbsup:
kevin: ok closing thread. meme for the road: https://imgs.example.com/semver-plant-meme.png
bot-ops: reminder: team lunch at 12:30 today — sign up on the sheet. (noted by maria)
